entries.contribution:
Yesterdays experiment was a success

As Jerry suggested last week, we are officially in Apple territory when it comes to brand positioning. 

Next step. Combining the following signals seems interesting 

- yesterday’s conversations

- ⁠outcome of our brand positioning 

- ⁠@⁨Garis Pang⁩ suggesting fractionalized ownership of a farm three years ago 

- ⁠@⁨Tiffine Wang⁩ suggestions to start a retreat center somewhere in Brazil area 

- ⁠Alex suggesting to get a plot of land for ESG purposes 

- ⁠Andrea wanting to get a plot of land to do Bitcoin mining 

- ⁠@⁨Matheus Reis - Bahia Coop⁩ suggestion to acquire a small plot of land for RnD 

- ⁠the experience me and @⁨Matheus Reis - Bahia Coop⁩ had of planting a cacao tree https://www.instagram.com/reel/C7hgV5svfF8/?igsh=MTV0ZHJtNnZoenV4bg==

- ⁠climate change causing cacao prices to continue staying elevated for the foreseeable future 

What if we acquired a cheap plot of deforested and allowed people to finance the planting and cultivation of a cacao tree. Thereafter direct a portion of the sales from the trees cacao to them or whoever happens to be holding the NFT representing the cacao tree??? 

Seems like an interesting experiment that might not be very expensive to run. But it will be a multi year one. Also while we are at it periodically hold retreats there… aka the Carnival of Truth, as described in our white paper, originally suggested by @⁨Garis Pang⁩ 🤔

https://truesight.me/whitepaper

narrative.text: Andrea Catalina Falcon Rios De Pabst contributed to the TrueSight DAO across multiple projects including 20250617_beerhall, Recurring Tokenizations, TrueSight DAO itself, and telegram_chatlog. Her efforts primarily focused on human effort tracked at 100TDG per hour, with 12 such contributions, alongside injecting liquidity at 1TDG per USD for 4 instances and additional hourly efforts. She is currently a member of the Board of Governors. Active from February 12, 2025, to March 13, 2026.
